## Parental OpControl 0.15.3

- My OpControl window: the custom title bar (shield logo, "My OpControl", "View only · set by your parents", minimize and close) now renders fully on Windows 10 1809 and later as well as Windows 11.
- Windows 10: no white top strip and no offset client area; the thick frame no longer hides the header.
- Maximized windows stay inside the monitor work area, with the taskbar and other monitors respected.
- Safety net: Esc closes the window (except the Messages-only window over the lock overlay), Alt+F4 works, and the taskbar thumbnail menu offers Restore, Minimize and Close.
- The window opens centered when there is no remembered position; the 90% size limit and visible-monitor clamping are unchanged.
- Other helper windows (message pop-up, Messages-only, lock overlay, countdown banner, PIN and override dialogs) were checked on Windows 10 and Windows 11.
